detail.longDescription:
RevMatch is a free research paper finder that uses AI to improve its relevance matching by using LLMs, either ones you use for a fee via API calls or free ones that you use locally on your machine via ollama.  It should provide better search results than using the vanilla search capabilities of the web endpoints of search engines like Semantic Scholar.

https://github.com/rxailab/RevMatch
